notes.title: Ice & Fire ! ❄️🔥 Ice blocks, Boom Crates, Polar & Volcano Battles🌋
notes.content:
[url=https://topplepop.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/25f3f8c1cd546b65d8f71a8b5fe0c85ae3bb790b.png[/img][/url]

[h2][url=https://topplepop.com][b]> SIGN UP FOR MONTHLY PLAYTESTS <[/b][/url][/h2]

Embrace the December [b]Frost-and-Flame[/b] Playtest! ❄️🔥
Ignite the competition as you blaze a trail to conquer the [b]Challenge leaderboards[/b]. Sharpen your frosty finesse in AI Battles, and send chills down your opponents' spines in Party Mode as you bury them under an avalanche of garbage!

[h4] New Polar & Volcano Zone Challenges 🌋[/h4] 
Take caution as you swing into the Polar & Volcano Zones — One Mis-step could lead to burnt or frozen feet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/973c428e0ed08ea9a736c9c984e3143eea101d8e.gif[/img]

[h4] Frosty Blocks & Boom Crates! [/h4]
Frozen blocks can't be color-matched. Crack the ice with adjacent combos, then smash through using Shoves and Throws. Be careful with Boom Crates! 🧨 Use a light touch or they'll explode and crack adjacent blocks - aim them carefully to clear a path, but [b][i]warning[/i][/b] - keep your Grumbles safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/02bfa2f6b54b5c78da40e11f2f8b0aceea6fbcd2.gif[/img]

[h4]Party Mix[/h4]
Want to play by your own rules? Mix it up in Party Mode against AI Bots, in Free-for-All or Co-op Teams with up to 3 friends local or online!
Practice with Boom Crates & Ice-Covered Blocks In the Fire & Ice Mix.

[h4]Challenge Mode[/h4]
Don't keep us in suspense — Reveal your top rescue times on the leaderboards! We're confident that you'll set the competition ablaze, if you don't let the ice slow you down!

[h4] Jump into sharing your game [/h4]
From a huge upsets to stunning victories! SHARE YOUR MOMENTS WITH US! Speed Runs or Huge Garbage Drops – Save and share your replay with us in our #replays channel on Discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/35d2ea4028e8c995cf6eeefa7646441e955fa361.gif[/img]

While on Discord, if you have questions, ideas or want to let us know what works or doesn’t work, please do so. We want to make each monthly playtest bigger and better than before.

[h3] Are you a content creator? [/h3]
Over our playtest weekends we love to tune into streamers and creators playing TopplePOP and will share your streams with our audience too. Those who bounce together, grow together! Join us on Discord and tell us your channel and when you’ll be streaming!

Finally, all you need to do to be involved with our playtest is head to TopplePOP.com and enter your email to receive your Steam key.

>> [url=https://topplepop.com][b]SIGN UP TO JOIN THE PLAYTEST[/b][/url] <<

Thanks to all that get involved for Your continued help making topplePOP the best i can be.

notes.title: October Tournament Balance changes
notes.content:
Thanks to our awesome playtesters for their thoughtful feedback!
For the latest round of intense competition, we've tweaked and rebalanced to reward skilfull play.

[h3]Goals:[/h3]
[list]
[*] reward active block placement and intentionally planned chain reactions
[*] reward acrobatic shoves & throws to clear garbage and upsize combos
[*] punish button-mashy rapid drops directly from the top of your playfield
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] characters will generally move faster especially delving downwards on their bungee
[*] if your character drops too many blocks too quickly, they'll get tired and need to catch their breath
[*] your character gets a very short burst of speed as they receive each next block
[/list]

Do these changes help achieve our goals and reward more skillful play? let us know - we'd love to hear your thoughts!

[h3]>> [url=https://linktr.ee/topplepop]Join the discussion![/url] <<[/h3]

[url=https://topplepop.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/658e3ceea0786565dcff9d369269c80385248269.png[/img][/url]

notes.content:

[h2][url=https://topplepop.com][b]> JOIN THE PLAYTEST <[/b][/url][/h2]

[h2][b]Playtest [/b][b]Week[/b][strike][i]end[/i][/strike][/h2]
Welcome to Playtest Week! Time to battle it out on the [b]challenge leaderboards[/b], Bury each other in garbage in Party Mode Vs, matches, and hone your blockbusting skills.

[b]Things are really beginning to heat up this month ♨️🥵 with...
[/b][h3] New VOLCANO Zone Challenges 🌋🔥[/h3] 
A wholly unique spin on the TopplePOP physics gameplay - hexagonal puzzle-pieces deep in a steamy caldera of hazardous magma - don't touch the hot stuff, and rescue the Grumbles before it erupts from below!

[h3] New Panda Character 🐼[/h3]
The ever-chill sifu of blockbusting, fiercely friendly, and so cuddly!

These blocks slide to fit neatly in Honeycomb formations for a unique twist on regular TopplePOP physics gameplay.

[h3]Party Mix[/h3]
Want to play by your own rules? Mix it up in Party Mode, in Free-for-All or Teams, with up to 3 friends.
We've also unlocked a volcano-only mix for those who LAVA good challenge!

[h3]Challenge Mode[/h3]
Climb the ranks on our prestigious Hall of Fame leaderboard as you conquer Challenge mode. Brace yourself to dive deep into these red-hot puzzles! 🌶️🌶️🌶️


[h2]Jump into sharing your game[/h2]
Did you catch that incredible combo?! From a certain loss to a stunning victory! SHARE YOUR MOMENTS WITH US! Whether it's an epic showdown, a blazing-fast speedrun, or even an unforgettable upset– Save and share your replay with us in our #replays channel on Discord as well as [url=https://twitter.com/topplepopreplay]@topplepopreplays[/url] for easy sharing. 

While on Discord, if you have questions, ideas or want to let us know what works or doesn’t work, please do so. We want to make each monthly playtest bigger and better than before.

[/h3]

notes.title: August Playtest Update!
notes.content:
[url=https://topplepop.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/be54838847a5211066d1b88e88ce13423d172c32.png[/img][/url]

>> [url=https://topplepop.com][b]SIGN UP TO JOIN THE PLAYTEST[/b][/url] <<

[h2][b]Playtest [/b][b]Week[/b][strike][i]end[/i][/strike][/h2]
Welcome to Playtest Week!, Thats right WEEK, we've decided to extend our monthly playtests to an entire week to allow You all more time to battle it out on the [b]challenge leaderboards[/b], Bury each other in garbage in versus games and hone your blockbusting skills.

[b]We've taken a decidedly cold approach to this month's offering including...
[/b][h3]❄️ New Polar Zone Challenges[/h3]
We're launching new and improved Polar puzzles that encourage you to delve deep into the puzzle (and icy waters) to rescue those grumpies before the sea levels rise too high!
[h3]🐻‍❄️ New Polar Bear Character[/h3]
Here to help clear up the jumble taking over the polar region and so cute I can [i]bear[/i]ly stand it 
[h3]🧊 Ice Coated Blocks[/h3]
Color matching is hindered by the ice coating. Pop adjacent blocks to shatter the ice, then give it a solid hit to clear it away, giving you access to the coloured block inside!

[h3]Party Mix[/h3]
Want to play by your own rules? Mix it up in Party Mode, in Free-for-All or Teams, with up to 3 friends.
We've also unlocked a polar-only mix in case you're looking to chill out in the ice.

[h3]Challenge Mode[/h3]
Climb the ranks on our prestigious Hall of Fame leaderboard as you conquer Challenge mode. Brace yourself for a mix of fresh Polar & Digital puzzles.

[h3]Team Battle Livestream with Puzzle Kingdom![/h3]
Our awesome friends at [b]Puzzle Kingdom[/b] will be livestreaming a friendly competition and showcasing all the new features - be sure to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1830114685]check out their TopplePOP videos[/url] - they're lots of fun! 
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1830114685][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/246303a5ce532850a851639070e2dd48dc9b52d2.png[/img][/url]

Whether it's an epic showdown, a blazing-fast speedrun, or even an unforgettable upset– Save and share your replay with us in our #replays channel on Discord as well as [url=https://twitter.com/topplepopreplay]@topplepopreplays[/url] for easy sharing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987630/6d68ee1f4108a850fb490bf83ef0527dbe8aa7a4.gif[/img]

While on Discord, if you have questions, ideas or want to let us know what works or doesn’t work, please do so. We want to make each monthly playtest bigger and better than before.

notes.title: MASSIVE March Playtest Update
notes.content:
It’s time to SPRING back into action with our next playtest!
From March 30th - April 2nd we’re opening the doors to our latest playtest weekend! This is a strictly time-limited playtest with new content so be sure to [url=https://topplepop.com][b]sign up[/b][/url] to claim your steam key.

[h2][b]What’s New In March?[/b][/h2]

With the turn of Spring, we’re springing back with our latest new character…Bunny!

Choose from the bouncing Bunny, the madcap Monkey or crazy Cat and take down those grumbles!
We’ve reworked our character models for a more modern and flashy design. It’s taken a while updating the gang with all new animations and physics, but we hope you will agree it has been worth the effort, giving them a new shine and adding a whole host of new outfits to boot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/021cf5b25dd5969b58210b3385a66ab00b532896.png[/img]

This month we’re headed out into the forest, so keep an eye out or those prickly blocks will get you! It’s all well and good swinging from bungees, but you’ll have to contend with swinging blocks too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/39a1da1cc94496cbd10d79b7a798fc2b3a6e5b3e.png[/img]

Play modes on offer over our March playtest:
[h2]Story mode[/h2]
Take your chosen character on an adventure in the first chapter of our one-player story mode.

[h2]Battle mode[/h2]
A new challenger has been added to Battle Mode - Battle against pro-blockbuster Millie in the Stadium arena.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814425/b0e68d29f18580f3f87bb2315d72faeea5d75b4f.png[/img]

[h2]Party Mix[/h2]
Want to play by your own rules? Make them up in Party Mix, either solo or play with up to 3 friends.
Challenge Mode
Do you think you’ve got the blocks to clear your way to the top of our leaderboard in our new Forest levels? Over the playtest, reach the top of our Hall of Fame for eternal TopplePOP glory!


[h3]Jump into sharing your game.[/h3]
Did you just clear a section in record time? Have you nicked the win in the last second? Whatever your game, save your replay and share with us over in our #replays channel on Discord. The best will feature in our monthly wrap up video, shared across our social channels!
Whilst you’re over on Discord, if you have questions, ideas or want to let us know what works or doesn’t work, please do so . We want to make each monthly playtest bigger and better than before.

[url=https://topplepop.com][b]SIGN UP FOR MONTHLY PLAYTESTS[/b][/url]

Are you a content creator?
Over our playtest weekends we love to tune into streamers and creators playing TopplePOP and will share your streams with our audience too. Those who bounce together, grow together. Head over to our Discord and send us a message telling us your channel and when you’ll be streaming!

Finally, all you need to do to be involved with our playtest is head to TopplePOP.com and enter your email to receive your Steam key.

We look forward to seeing you bounce!
